title: decode() delegation to decode_limited(None) is the right design and should be defended
description: A future contributor might suggest 'inlining decode() for clarity' or 'keeping decode() independent for testability'. Both suggestions should be rejected: (1) The single-source-of-truth principle means any future fix to decode_limited() applies to decode() for free. (2) All decode() behavioral tests remain valid as-is — they test through the delegation and cover the full logic path. (3) The delegation is a 1-liner with a doc comment that makes the relationship explicit. Keep the delegation.
close_reason: Design decision stands: decode() delegation to decode_limited(None) is correct single-source-of-truth.
